notes.made: --init, then by hand: lock head (round 2b, the 26 hand-drawn runs: 「也要做」 - her drawn run redraws the upper body every frame, so only the head is one drawing, Ezreal v2's way; the fur collar, the jacket, the arms, the gun and the legs stay each frame's own drawing)
notes.head: her two spiky tails, the yellow hair with its strands down to the fur collar, the face (frame 7's: both eyes open, 30 rows from the tails' tips to the jaw - the frames' own heads are 28-32 rows: frame 2's would not take a taller one); the drawn heads are 8 drawings (IoU 0.47-0.54 against frame 7's: the tails, the strands and the eyes redrawn every frame)
notes.chin: frame 7's first row under the jaw
notes.bob: the drawn one (the head where each frame drew its own, the jaw on the drawn jaw)
notes.variants: char: head_match_colours = her eye white and skin (the columns), chin_rows = each frame's jaw row (the lowest skin row of the face's right part: a bare neck shows under its left) with head_align chin (the rows); clear_all, clear_grow 3 (the drawn tails reach up to 3 squares past frame 7's); keep_colours = the fur collar and the orange scarf; beside_head ground (what the drawn heads leave beside the laid one is ground - filled from the colours round it, the fur collar grew into the strands' place); the head's lower left stops where frame 7's own dark shadow would come out thicker than the outline (the outline pass took 6-10 squares off it in every other frame)
notes.face: the use variant (11-16, after the user's 「艾克头发为什么没有动画了？」 and 「全部查一遍」: the char head lock froze her two pigtail tufts and the hair strands, which the artist redrew every frame - tips 4-6 squares round the cycle): frame 7's face only (skin, both eyes with their lids and whites, the brow marks, the jaw's outline; 65 squares) on the frame's own skin and eye white (offset 0 every frame); only the face's colours cleared (head_colours: skin, shadow, eye white, brow browns, lip red) inside clear_poly; the face's outer ring (forehead under the bangs, the left eye's outer corner and cheek edge, the right edge, the jaw's right end) laid under the hair (head_under), so every frame's own tufts, strands and their outline stay as drawn; gaps filled from the hair or outline, never skin or the fur collar (fill_skip)
notes.char_variant: variant char: the installed head lock (8be44b085: tufts, strands and face of frame 7) - it froze the hair, kept for the review lane
